WITH counts AS (
  SELECT p.player_id, COUNT(ma.player_id) as award_count
  FROM player p
  LEFT JOIN manager_award ma ON p.player_id = ma.player_id
  GROUP BY p.player_id
),
total AS (
  SELECT SUM(award_count) as total_awards FROM counts
)
SELECT 
  c.player_id,
  c.award_count,
  CAST(c.award_count AS REAL) / t.total_awards as fraction
FROM counts c
CROSS JOIN total t
WHERE t.total_awards IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 
  fraction DESC
LIMIT 10
